title: Spring start-up and repairs in Rockland

seo.title: Sample project: Rockland irrigation start-up | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a Rockland heritage garden's irrigation started up after frost damage, repaired and set to CRD lawn days.

summary: Start-up of a heritage garden's system after a cold snap cracked lines.
challenge: The system had not been drained before a cold snap, and two lines cracked.
approach: We charged the system slowly, found and repaired the two cracked lines and adjusted the heads away from the heritage stonework.
The controller was set to the CRD lawn watering days before Stage 1 began on May 1.
result: System running before the watering season, with a reminder booked for fall shutdown.
